messages:
maria: FYI hitting a weird HF -> Redwood import failure for big-chat-3b. Converter starts streaming shards but after a couple of hub retries some safetensors shards appear to have a 16-byte header shift, which makes weight names misalign and tokenizer special tokens disappear.

maria: minimal repro logs:
```
I2026-03-20T10:12:34Z downloader: GET https://huggingface.co/owner/big-chat-3b/resolve/main/pytorch_model-00001-of-00010.safetensors 200 OK
I2026-03-20T10:12:34Z stream: writing chunk 0..65536
W2026-03-20T10:12:35Z retry: transient 403, backing off and re-issuing range request
I2026-03-20T10:12:36Z downloader: resumed range 65537..131072, wrote to tempfile
E2026-03-20T10:12:36Z safetensors: header parse failed: unexpected magic at offset 0x10
E2026-03-20T10:12:36Z converter: wasm-loader: weight key parse mismatch, expected 'transformer.h.0.attn.q.weight' but found 'transformer.h.0.attn.k.weight'
```

maria: observed symptoms in model: chat templates lost <|system|> token mapping, tokenizer.pad_id changed from 0->1 in the produced vocab, samples produce early EOS.

daniel: Interesting — so the range resume wrote into the middle of the tempfile (off-by-one chunk) and we didn't re-seek header parsing? Could be our streaming path that uses http range + tempfile.append without aligning the safetensors header.

maria: yeah looks like when the downloader gets a 403 and then resumes with a new Range it uses "wb+" and f.seek(pos) but pos is computed from bytes_written, off by header length detection.

convert-bot: converter v1.14.2 detected non-monotonic shard offsets, aborting conversion. Suggested action: run `rw-convert --repair-shard-index` (beta).

taylor: Can you dump the first 64 bytes of the shard before/after the resume? Also share the shard index (.safetensors.index) — maybe HF hub served a partial range causing header duplication.

maria: pasted diffs:
```
# before resume (first 48 bytes)
0000: 73 61 66 65 74 65 6e 73 00 02 00 00 00 00 00 20  safetens......
# after resume (first 48 bytes)
0000: 73 61 66 65 74 65 6e 73 00 02 00 00 00 00 00 00 39  ... header shifted by 16
```

daniel: ok that 0x20 vs 0x00 at offset 0x0e indicates our write pointer landed inside the header region and we overwrote bytes. That will definitely change the name table offsets.

taylor: quick mitigation: have the downloader treat safetensors downloads as atomic: if any retry/resume occurs, write to a new tempfile then concat/verify later. That avoids partial header corruption. Patch looks small.

maria: I tried `--no-resume` and converter completed, but model still had token index diffs — I think revpin metadata mismatch caused our tokenizer.json to be loaded from a different revision (old vocab) because the shard index parse failed and we fell back to hub metadata cache. So two simultaneous issues: header-shift + revpin fallback.

convert-bot: created issue RW-ML-3891: "downloader: safetensors resume can corrupt header -> weight name offsets". Assigned to @daniel.

daniel: I'll prepare a patch: change resume path to write new tempfile and validate safetensors magic header before merging. Also add an invariant check in converter: verify total size + name table CRC before trusting weight key offsets.

maria: thanks. For immediate unblock, I re-uploaded a copy of the model to our internal staging bucket and converted that copy successfully (no range requests). Sharing conversion artifacts: s3://redwood-staging/big-chat-3b/converted-v1/

taylor: Can we add an e2e test that simulates HTTP 403 mid-shard and verify the downloader doesn't corrupt header? That should catch regressions.

daniel: yes adding unit test + integration job. Will also add a quick alert in infra if safetensors header parse fails more than 3x in an hour.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: downloader/resume-fix branch -> staging (pr #1457). ETA 15m.

maria: verified staging run after deploy: no header errors, tokenizer mapping preserved, chat template still intact. :tada:

taylor: follow-ups: 1) add a converter sanity check that compares tokenizer.vocab sha against model metadata revpin, 2) audit other streaming formats (npz, ckpt) for similar resume hazards.

maria: filed RW-ML-3892 for tokenizer revpin sanity check. Good catch everyone.

convert-bot: closing advisory thread; keep RW-ML-3891/3892 open until GA.
